title: INCOLOR current service and warranty terms
notes: Current manufacturer service terms give INCOLOR carbon frames and forks lifetime coverage from receipt for qualifying original-purchaser manufacturing/design issues; listed INCOLOR wheels, cockpit and other carbon parts have shorter stated terms, and compatible metal parts have 2 years. Mainland freight for covered quality issues is borne by INCOLOR. Collision, misuse, poor assembly, natural disasters and wear are excluded; non-INCOLOR components in a custom build are not covered by this platform warranty.
